about.lead: My passion is creating content that conveys experiences. Stories to be told.
body: For the past 10 years I've worked in the industry, always inside agencies and production companies.
This site is something else. It's my personal project: a home for the work that's mine, and a truer reflection of what I make when the story is my own.

homeIntro.heading: Filmmaker in Vitoria-Gasteiz, Basque Country
homeIntro.text: I'm Julen De La Serna, a filmmaker and director of photography based in Vitoria-Gasteiz. I direct and shoot music videos, documentaries and branded content for artists, brands and production companies across the Basque Country.
homeIntro.es: Filmmaker y director de fotografía en Vitoria-Gasteiz, País Vasco (Euskadi). Videoclips, documentales y contenido de marca.

faq.a: I'm based in Vitoria-Gasteiz, in the Basque Country, and I work across the region: Álava, Bizkaia and Gipuzkoa.
I direct and shoot as director of photography: music videos, documentaries, storytelling pieces and branded video content.

faq.q: Do you have your own equipment?
faq.a: Yes. I shoot with my own gear and work with cameras and tools from RED, Blackmagic, Sony, Freefly and DJI.

faq.q: Can you work outside the Basque Country?
faq.a: My base is Vitoria-Gasteiz, but if your project is somewhere else, write to me and we'll see how to make it work.

faq.q: How can I hire you or start a project?
faq.a: Tell me about your idea through the contact page. I'll reply as soon as I can.
